description: The file defines the PatientAgent class responsible for managing conversational interactions with patients, gathering symptom information through slot filling, and generating structured notes. It includes methods for handling dialogue state, extracting answers from message history, determining what information is needed, and responding appropriately in a medical chatbot context.

classes.name: PatientAgent
classes.description: A conversational agent that manages symptom inquiry, state tracking, and note structuring for patient interactions in a medical chatbot system.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the PatientAgent with slot markers and base slots.

methods.name: Set[str] _asked_slots_from_history(self, history: List[Message])
methods.description: Extracts which slots have been asked based on the assistant's messages in conversation history.

methods.name: Set[str] _answered_slots_from_history(self, history: List[Message])
methods.description: Infers which slots have been answered based on recent user messages using heuristic patterns.

methods.name: bool _needs_temperature(self, history: List[Message], current_user_text: str)
methods.description: Determines whether temperature information is needed based on conversation history and current user input.

methods.name: bool _needs_pain_location(self, history: List[Message], current_user_text: str)
methods.description: Determines whether pain location information is needed based on conversation history and current user input.

methods.name: bool _triage_complete(self, asked: Set[str], answered: Set[str], needs_temp: bool, needs_pain_loc: bool)
methods.description: Checks if all required information slots are answered, considering conditional needs for temperature and pain location.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict[str,object]] respond( self, history: List[Message], user_text: str, asked_slots: Set[str] = None, answered_slots: Set[str] = None, )
methods.description: Generates a response to the user, asking for missing information or concluding if triage is complete. Maintains and updates the dialogue state.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] structure_notes(self, history: List[Message])
methods.description: Creates a structured summary of the patient's symptom conversation, including chief complaint and key questions.
